name: Box Internet
summary: Adelaide ISP (S@t Internet Services, Silicom Pty Ltd), successor to SATECH; taken over by Chariot.

events.details: Box Internet / S@t Internet Services (same Silicom entity as SATECH), Adelaide. Earliest box.net.au capture Dec 1996; 1998 site shows 'S@t Internet Services' dialup plans.
Taken over by Chariot: box.net.au had become 'Chariot Netconnect' by mid-2002 (Chariot service@chariot.net.au, SA/VIC/QLD/NSW sites by 2004).
